helpContent.description: This tab shows statistics about feedback that users provide when correcting parser results. This data helps improve parser quality.
helpContent.stats: The statistics show the total number of feedback entries, the average quality score, and the most common issues.
helpContent.usage: Use the time period filter to view feedback from different time periods. The distribution by provider shows which parsers are corrected most frequently. The most common issues help identify areas for improvement.

helpContent.description: This tab analyzes parser feedback and suggests improvements for the regex patterns used to parse emails and boarding passes.

helpContent.autoApply: The Auto-Apply function automatically applies all suggestions with a confidence of ≥90%. You can also manually review and apply individual suggestions.
